The '''Rhamalai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Varada sector/Legends|Varada sector]]. A system in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], it contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]].
